11.41: sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ mayā pramādātpraṇayena vāpi
11.43: pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān
11.44: piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
11.45: adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
11.46: kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahasta micchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
11.47: mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
11.48: na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānai rna ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
11.49: mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya
11.50: ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
11.53: nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
11.54: jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
11.55: nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
12.2: mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate
12.6: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥ
12.8: mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
12.9: atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram
12.13: adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca
12.15: harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
12.16: sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
12.17: yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati
12.18: samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
13.0: prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca
13.1: etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
13.2: kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata
13.3: tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛk ca yadvikāri yataśca yat
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu
13.16: avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
13.17: jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
13.18: iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ
13.23: ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥsaha
13.28: na hinastyātmanā''tmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim
13.30: tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma sampadyate tadā
13.31: śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
13.33: kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
13.34: bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
14.1: yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
14.2: sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
14.9: sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
14.10: rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā
14.14: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt
14.17: sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
14.18: ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ
14.22: prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava
na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
15.1: chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
15.3: na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā
15.4: tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
15.6: na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
15.9: śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca
15.10: utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam
15.13: puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
15.15: sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca
15.16: dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca
15.18: ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
16.6: dvau bhūtasargau loke'smin daiva āsura eva ca
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
16.7: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
16.18: ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ
16.23: na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
17.1: teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ
17.2: trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu
17.3: śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
17.5: aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
17.8: rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
17.10: yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
17.12: abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
17.15: anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat
17.20: deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam
17.21: dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
17.26: praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
17.27: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate
17.28: aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha
18.2: kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ
18.4: niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama
18.6: etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca
18.8: sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet
18.9: saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
18.11: na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ
18.12: aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit
18.14: adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham
18.15: nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ
18.16: tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ
18.17: yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate
hatvāpi sa imām̐llokānna hanti na nibadhyate
18.19: jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ
18.21: vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam
18.24: yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ
18.28: viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
18.30: pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
18.31: yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca
18.34: prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
18.35: yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
18.36: sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha
18.40: na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ
18.45: sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ
18.48: sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet
18.50: siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
18.51: buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyā''tmānaṃ niyamya ca
18.53: ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham
18.54: brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
18.55: tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
18.64: sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
iṣṭo'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
18.65: manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me
18.66: ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
18.67: na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati
18.69: bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
18.70: adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ
18.77: vismayo me mahān rājan hṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
18.78: yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ
